qualitative.decay_resistance: old-growth rated durable to very durable; younger-tree wood rated moderately durable
qualitative.workability: sharp cutters and light passes recommended to avoid tearout; good gluing, nailing, finishing, and paint-holding properties
qualitative.fastener_behavior: good nailing properties reported by source
qualitative.grain_behavior: straight grain, medium to coarse texture; raw unfinished surfaces may feel greasy
qualitative.dimensional_stability: not separately scored in this record

availability.legal_sourcing_notes: Wood Database states this species is not listed in the CITES Appendices and is reported by IUCN as least concern.
availability.market_notes: Specialty lumber such as reclaimed sinker cypress or pecky cypress is much more expensive than construction-grade material.

fabrication_notes: USDA FPL Wood Handbook Chapter 5 Table 5-3a independently lists baldcypress at 12 percent MC with specific gravity 0.46, MOR 73,000 kPa, MOE 9,900 MPa, compression parallel 43,900 kPa, and side hardness 2,300 N.
unknowns: sinker or ancient-grade mechanical differences are not assumed in this standard record
references: USDA Forest Products Laboratory, Wood Handbook FPL-GTR-282, Chapter 5, Table 5-3a: https://www.fpl.fs.usda.gov/documnts/fplgtr/fplgtr282/chapter_05_fpl_gtr282.pdf
